newsitem.title: FINLAND: IVO sees possible synergies with Neste.
newsitem.headline: IVO sees possible synergies with Neste.

text.p: Finnish state-owned power producer Imatran Voima (IVO) CEO Heikki Marttinen said on Tuesday he saw some potential synergies with parts of oil, energy and chemicals group Neste.
"I believe that there could be synergies in some areas, but also there are clearly areas where there would not be," he told Reuters by telephone.
Neste said earlier that the state would probe broadening IVO's and Neste's ownership base and possible co-development of the two groups. The state now also owns 84 percent of Neste.

Marttinen said it was up to the government to decide what it wanted to do with its companies and that the investigation was driven by energy and competition policy, while IVO remained prepared for privatisations through a share issue and listing.
"Neste and IVO together have core competences across the whole energy chain," Neste said in an earlier statement.
IVO said in a separate statement that the study would be completed by the end of August.
"Our group is strategically and financially in good shape, and has a very efficient staff and structure," Marttinen said.
